text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, 
three full years had passed 
since I first began walking alongside <chrname>.

Some things had become distant memories, 
while others had faded away entirely— 
or so it seemed to me.

Holding this mysterious horseshoe brought 
peace to my heart. 
Yet where had I obtained it...? 
By now, even that had become hazy.

Three years is a long time. 
The Umamusume honing their skills together 
at Tracen Academy 
all seemed to have gained fruitful 
experiences of their own.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
The turf's looking sparkling clean again 
today~! 
Thanks for working so early, staff guys!

text_block_list.name: Groundskeeper
text_block_list.text:
Don't mention it! Seeing you girls run 
to your hearts' content, Blast-chan, 
is what makes us happiest!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Blast just loves this track! 
The turf is nice and soft, and the dirt 
feels just right.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Plus—everyone's heartfelt wishes are 
carried on it, 
so I feel like there's no limit to how 
strong I can get!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"No Reason-san! 
All of us from Soma came to cheer for 
you~!" 
"Give it your all, our savior—!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha! 
I have truly become quite the popular one, 
haven't I?!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
In every era, it was humankind 
who handed down the tales of Umamusume 
battles to future generations.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
—O mortals, beholders of our legacy! 
Open wide thine eyes and witness this 
grand contest!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Yuki-chan, are you all set?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yep! ...Still, I never dreamt we'd be 
throwin' 
such a huge fan meeting right here in 
Morioka~.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course we are! 
Our rising star is now the "city girl" 
that so many girls look up to!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Is that so... Hehe, really, huh? 
Alright then! Wearin' this outfit packed 
with everyone's hopes, 
I'm gonna show 'em what real cool looks 
like...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for comin' out to watch Maya's 
race☆ 
Cheering so hard for me gave me a whole 
bunch of energy!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
To the one I adore, to the one who means 
the world to me, 
I'm gonna pour my whole heart into this 
song—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
So don't you dare look away, okay? 
...You copy?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: I COPYYYYYYY!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Daiwa Scarlet!" 
"Scarlet, we came to see you—!"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
They are calling your name quite a lot, 
Scarlet. 
However, I have no intention of 
surrendering 
the title of number one mascot, you know?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Just what I wanted to hear. 
I'll answer every single voice out 
there... 
and become the most unforgettable 
Umamusume of all!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heh, when it comes to being cool, I'm 
miles ahead of you two! 
—Bring it on, both of you!

<chrname> and I were changing, too. 
Side by side, walking together toward the 
future.
choice_data_list:
Alright, let's give today's training 
everything we've got!

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Everyone... 
What truly strong, dazzling figures you 
have become.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
You too, Trainer, 
have grown far sturdier than you were back 
then.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Searching for books, wandering through the 
town. 
Spending those fleeting moments together—

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Ever since that time... 
when my bond with you deepened, if only a 
little.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Existing beside mankind. Walking beside 
mankind. 
Thanks to you, 
I was able to experience that precious 
endeavor for myself.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
...On that final day, 
I may have allowed myself to become a bit 
greedy. 
I am still quite lacking in maturity, it 
seems.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
And yet... 
it was a truly peaceful, comforting time.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: —Lord <username>.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Though we may be apart... and in all the 
days to come. 
I shall continue to watch over your 
journey.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
May the dream you pursue alongside Lady <chrname> 
blossom and bear fruitful results.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: Here, in solitude, I shall keep praying.

For a moment, I thought I heard someone 
call my name. 
...Yet when I turned around, nobody was 
there.

Even so, 
it felt as though the horseshoe I carried 
as a good luck charm 
had grown ever so slightly warm.
